content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Travel lodging and experiences marketplace serving travelers, unlike Etsy's marketplace for independent sellers of handmade and resale goods."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Home repair service matching sells professional services to homeowners, not goods sold by independent sellers to shoppers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Freight and utility bill payment and bank deposit services for corporate clients, not a consumer goods marketplace."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Freight forwarding and customs brokerage for importers and exporters, a logistics service rather than a goods marketplace."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"B2B marketplace where the company buys and resells bulky merchandise to business buyers, not consumer marketplace for independent sellers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Truckload and intermodal trucking services for shippers, an asset-based transportation business unlike Etsy."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and software sold to merchants, a B2B technology vendor rather than a consumer marketplace."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and marketing agency work for large brands, a services business without a marketplace for sellers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Online auctions of used industrial equipment to dealers and contractors, a B2B marketplace for different products and buyers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Marketing, advertising and public relations agency services for corporate brands, not an online marketplace."}]}
